body:
## Summary

- The alloc tests assert only upper bounds: `<= 40` for `apply` (`tests/alloc.rs:109`) and `<= 30` for `apply_owned` (`:145`). The "35 / 25" numbers are documented in `CHANGELOG.md:51` and `DIVERGENCES.md:38,61,65`, not asserted by the tests.
- Both tests cover exactly one scenario on a 1-block flat document: insert `"x"` at `Pos(1)` in `"hello"`. No chunked path, no delete/mark/split/join, no capacity-growth case, no S2.
- The owned insert path statically accounts for ~15 allocations (flat, unique `DocInner`) vs ~20 for immutable `apply`; the documented measurements are 25/35, so ~10–15 small allocations per path are not individually visible in source (Vec growth/boxed-slice shrink and testing-harness setup). Treat 25/35 as authoritative, the ledger below as the fixed-cost decomposition.
- **The owned path is slower in practice because the public wrapper defeats it**: `Editor::apply` clones the whole `EditorState` before calling `apply_owned` (`editor.rs:160-162`), so `self.state` still holds the `Doc` Arc and `Arc::get_mut` at `doc.rs:158` fails. `apply_owned` then falls back to the immutable chunk/directory copy path. Any benchmark that feeds a consumed state forward also accumulates `History` and pays `History::trim`'s `Vec::remove(0)` + `done_bytes()` per edit (`history.rs:230-241`), which the immutable benchmark never pays.
- Bench coverage is thin: only S1/S2, both built as 1 run per block, only `apply`, serialization, parse, and a11y. No `apply_owned`, no S0/S3/S4, no delete/mark/split/join/multi-step/undo, no iai/baseline.

## 1. Allocation tests — exact content

`crates/rich-editor-auy/tests/alloc.rs`

| Test | Setup | Measured | Assertion | Documented measured |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `one_character_insertion_has_a_bounded_allocation_count` (`:75-113`) | schema basic, 1 paragraph block, one run `"hello"` (`:91-94`); `transaction.insert_text(Pos(1), "x")` (`:102`) | `reset()` after transaction construction (`:103`), then `state.apply(transaction)` (`:104`) — **no `clone()` measured** | `allocations() <= 40` (`:108-112`) | 35 (`CHANGELOG.md:51`, `DIVERGENCES.md:65`) |
| `owned_insert_avoids_directory_copies` (`:116-149`) | same doc (`:132-135`) | `reset()` (`:141`), then `state.apply_owned(transaction)` (`:142`) | `allocations() <= 30` (`:144-148`) | 25 (`CHANGELOG.md:51`, `DIVERGENCES.md:38,61,65`) |

The counting allocator increments on `alloc`, `realloc`, and `alloc_zeroed` (`:34-62`), so every `Vec` reallocation and `into_boxed_slice` shrink counts. There is no exact-equality assertion and no byte ceiling in `alloc.rs`; bytes are only checked in `tests/memory.rs` (`:110-118`, budget from `plan/05` §2.5).

Naming mismatch: the owned test is named "avoids_directory_copies" but the fixture has 1 block, i.e. the flat chunk (`chunks.rs:41-53`), so it never exercises the directory.

## 2. Allocation ledger — single-char insert, 1-block flat doc

Transaction construction is excluded in `alloc.rs` (built before `reset`). If `state.apply(transaction.clone())` is measured (as in `bench/hot_path.rs:35`), add **+2**: `Vec<Step>` clone and `Slice.text: Box<str>` `"x"` clone (`step/mod.rs:16-24` derive `Clone`; `Slice` at `:30-42`).

### Immutable `apply(transaction)` — static lower bound ≈ 20

| # | Site | Allocation |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `state/mod.rs:154` `let mut inverse = Vec::new();` + push at `:160` | 1 × `Vec<Step>` |
| 2 | `step/invert.rs:57` → `text_between_block` → `text_edit::slice_text` for an empty range | 0 |
| 3 | `step/invert.rs:63` `Slice::from_textblock`: empty `String::into_boxed_str`, empty `TextBlock` | 0 |
| 4 | `step/apply.rs:161` `apply_step` → `:118 replace` → `replace_owned(doc.clone())` | 0 (Arc bump) |
| 5 | `step/text_edit.rs:275` `String::from(text)` for inserted `"x"` | 1 |
| 6 | `step/text_edit.rs:54` `items.push` (first Vec growth) | 1 |
| 7 | `step/text_edit.rs:57` `items.push(item.clone())` → `String` clone of `"hello"` | 1 |
| 8 | `model/text.rs:91` `Vec::with_capacity(items.len())` in `TextBlock::new` | 1 |
| 9 | `model/text.rs:116` `previous.text.push_str(&run.text)` merge `"x"+"hello"` → realloc | 1 |
| 10 | `model/text.rs:185` `normalized` Vec first push in `normalize` | 1 |
| 11 | `model/text.rs:210` `String::from(slice)` — full text copied again | 1 |
| 12 | `step/apply.rs:98` `block.attrs().clone()` | 0 for empty attrs; ≥1 + deep `AttrValue` copies when attrs exist (e.g. node IDs) |
| 13 | `model/chunk.rs:93` `blocks.to_vec()` (`replacing_flat`) | 1 |
| 14 | `model/chunk.rs:95` `starts.to_vec()` | 1 |
| 15 | `model/chunk.rs:94` `*slot = Arc::new(block)` | 1 |
| 16 | `model/doc.rs:146` `Arc::new(DocInner { .. })` | 1 |
| 17 | `step/map.rs:62` `Box::new([StepMapRange])` in `StepMap::replacement` | 1 |
| 18 | `step/map.rs:136` `self.maps.to_vec()` (empty, 0) + `push` (1) + `into_boxed_slice` shrink 4→1 (1) | 2 |
| 19 | `state/mod.rs:189` `transaction.steps().to_vec()` | 1 |
| 20 | `state/mod.rs:189` cloning each `Step` → `Slice.text: Box<str>` | 1 |
| 21 | `state/history.rs:173` `self.done.push(group)` | 1 |
| 22 | `state/change.rs:72` `ranges.push` | 1 |
| 23 | `state/change.rs:115` `ranges.into_boxed_slice()` shrink 4→1 | 1 |

Fixed costs by subsystem: text splice **7**, chunk snapshot **4** (flat) or **7** (chunked: `chunks.rs:217`, `:225`, `chunk.rs:92`, `:95`, `Arc<Chunk>`, `Arc<Block>`, `Arc<DocInner>`), step maps **3**, inverse **1**, history **3**, change set **2**.

### `apply_owned(transaction)` — static lower bound ≈ 15 (unique `DocInner`)

Same text splice 7, inverse 1, attrs 0, map 3, change set 2, and:

| Site | Owned cost | Immutable cost |
|---|---|---|
| `doc.rs:158` `Arc::get_mut` succeeds → `chunks/in_place.rs:34-42` / `:77-101` | 0 | — |
| `chunk.rs:80` `*slot = Arc::new(block)` inside `replace_in_place` | 1 | 1 |
| `chunk.rs:93,95` blocks/starts copies | **0** | 1 + 1 |
| `chunks.rs:217,225` directory/starts copies | **0** | 1 + 1 |
| `chunks.rs:209`/`doc.rs:146` new container | **0** (`DocInner` mutated) | 1 (+ `Arc<Chunk>` 1 in chunked) |
| `mod.rs:189` steps clone | **0** (steps moved into `Group` at `apply_owned.rs:73`) | 2 |
| `history.rs:173` | 1 | 1 |

Owned S2 unique therefore also ≈15 — no directory, no chunk copy, `starts` fix-ups are in-place suffix updates (`chunk.rs:81-82`, `in_place.rs:98-101`). This is the intended fast path; the documented 25 µs-path number corresponds to the fallback case (see §3).

## 3. `apply_owned`: base removal, remaining allocations, why slower

**Base snapshot removal** — `state/apply_owned.rs:20-21`:

```rust
pub fn apply_owned(self, mut transaction: Transaction) -> Result<Applied, ApplyError> {
    transaction.base = None;
```

`Transaction::with_base` (`state/transaction.rs:59-63`) stores `base = Some(doc.clone())` whenever the transaction comes from `EditorState::transaction` (`state/mod.rs:132`). That base Arc is the second strong reference keeping `DocInner` shared, so dropping it is required before `Arc::get_mut` at `doc.rs:158` can succeed. Remaining per-apply allocations are the inverse Vec/Step/Slice, the step maps, the `Group` metadata Vec, the `ChangeSet` box, the new `Arc<Block>`, and the rewritten run strings — the same text/map/history costs as immutable apply.

**Why 3.65 µs > 2.89 µs (S2).** Two concrete mechanisms, both visible in source:

1. **The wrapper shares the Arc.** `state/editor.rs:160-167`:
   ```rust
   pub fn apply(&mut self, transaction: Transaction) -> Result<AppliedInfo, ApplyError> {
       let state = self.state.clone();
       let applied = state.apply_owned(transaction)?;
   ```
   `self.state` retains its `Doc` while `state` is consumed, so at `doc.rs:158` the strong count is 2. `Arc::get_mut` fails and `replacing_block_owned` calls `self.replacing_block(...)` (`doc.rs:162`), i.e. the full immutable path: `Chunks::replacing_chunked` copies the directory and `starts` (`chunks.rs:217,225`) and `Chunk::replacing` copies the touched chunk's blocks and starts (`chunk.rs:92,95`). The owned call therefore pays immutable costs **plus** the state clone and base drop, which explains "owned slower than immutable".
2. **A repeatable owned benchmark must consume state forward.** Criterion cannot call `apply_owned` twice on one state; feeding `applied.state` into the next iteration accumulates `History`. After 200 groups, every `record` runs `trim` (`history.rs:230-241`): `done.remove(0)` shifts 200 `Group`s and `done_bytes()` sums all 200 per edit — work the immutable benchmark (fixed `&state`, empty history every iteration) never does. `history.info()` (`editor.rs:252-256`) repeats the sum in the wrapper. This can easily account for ~0.7 µs. `[INFERENCE]` — the bench file contains no owned measurement to confirm; see §6.

There is **no** full `Doc::new`/measure recomputation on either path: `Doc::replacing_block` only rechecks the replacement block (`doc.rs:138-149`, `chunks.rs:154`). The "double work" is copies, not measurement.

`apply_owned` also does not implement the rollback promised by `plan/04_arquitetura.md:420-422`; a failing later step drops the partially mutated state via `?` (`apply_owned.rs:48-50`). That is why `Editor::apply` has to clone in the first place.

## 4. Chunk storage description

- Threshold: `CHUNK_BLOCKS = 128` (`model/chunks.rs:28`). `Chunks::new` (`:41-75`): `<= 128` blocks → one inline `flat: Option<Chunk>`; otherwise a `directory: Box<[Arc<Chunk>]>` plus a parallel `starts: Box<[u32]>` of chunk byte offsets.
- `Chunk` (`model/chunk.rs:14-37`): `blocks: Box<[Arc<Block>]>`, `starts: Box<[u32]>` of block offsets **relative to the chunk**, `size: u32`.
- Lookup: `Chunks::get`/`range`/`at` (`chunks.rs:92-137`) divide by 128 or `partition_point` over chunk `starts`; `Chunk::at` (`chunk.rs:58-64`) partitions its own `starts`. Flat docs delegate directly (`chunks.rs:92-100, 115-121`).
- `starts` maintenance: built once (`chunk.rs:25-36`); suffix-updated after a replace in-place (`chunk.rs:81-83`, `chunks/in_place.rs:98-101`) and in copy-on-write (`chunk.rs:96-97`, `chunks.rs:226-228`).
- `Arc::get_mut` usage: `doc.rs:158` (whole `DocInner`), `chunks/in_place.rs:83` (one `Arc<Chunk>`). If either is shared, the code falls back to cloning: `Doc::replacing_block` (`doc.rs:138-162`), `Chunks::replacing_chunked` (`chunks.rs:191-246`), `Chunk::replacing` (`chunk.rs:88-104`).
- Copied per edit:
  - flat + unique: nothing except `Arc::new(Block)` and in-place suffix `starts` update;
  - flat + shared/immutable: blocks Box, starts Box, `Arc<Block>`, `Arc<DocInner>`;
  - chunked + unique: nothing except `Arc::new(Block)` and suffix updates;
  - chunked + shared/immutable: chunk blocks Box, chunk starts Box, `Arc<Chunk>`, directory Box, chunk-start Box, `Arc<Block>`, `Arc<DocInner>`.
- `Chunks::to_vec` / `BlockSeq::to_vec` (`chunks.rs:139-141`, `block_seq.rs:49-51`) are O(blocks) and used by structural ops (`step/structural.rs:34-40`, `step/apply.rs:194-200`, table rebuilds), not by the insert hot path.

## 5. Concrete optimizations, ordered by risk/benefit

| # | Change | Function(s) | Expected delta | Risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Make `Editor::apply` not clone the state; add an owned apply that takes `&mut EditorState` (or returns the state with the error) and rolls back via `inverse` in reverse with `apply_step_owned` on failure. Then `Arc::get_mut` succeeds. | `state/editor.rs:160-167`, `state/apply_owned.rs:20-81`, `model/doc.rs:152-163` | Owned S2: **−5 allocs** (directory, starts, chunk blocks, chunk starts, `Arc<Chunk>`) and ~2.5 KiB copies; flat **−3**. This is the root-cause fix for 3.65 µs > 2.89 µs. | Medium: error-path atomicity/rollback; existing rustdoc says the state is not reused on error, so define/lock the contract + add a `transaction_failure_is_atomic` test. |
| 2 | Skip building `Mapping` unless it will be consumed. `mapping` is only used to map `self.selection`; if the transaction carries an explicit selection, or the state selection is `None`/`Table` (`selection.rs:127-147` returns self), it is dead work. | `state/mod.rs:155-162`, `state/apply_owned.rs:43-50`, `step/map.rs:135-141` | **−3 allocs** (StepMap Box + Mapping push + shrink realloc) on every apply without selection mapping — including both alloc tests. | Low. Condition on `transaction.selection().is_none() && !matches!(self.selection, Selection::None \| Selection::Table{..})`. |
| 3 | Early-return in `TextBlock::normalize` when every run is already `<= ceiling`. `TextBlock::new` already merges equal-mark runs; for typical edits nothing exceeds 4 KiB, yet normalize rebuilds the whole Vec and re-allocates every `String`. | `model/text.rs:183-222` | **−2 allocs** per edited block (normalized Vec + `String::from(slice)`), and removes a full text copy. | Low: idempotent; keep `recompute_len()` on the early path. |
| 4 | Fast path in `replace_text` for pure insertion (`start == end`) at/inside one run: build one `String::with_capacity(run.len + insert.len)`, copy prefix+insert+suffix once; skip `push_text` + run clone + `push_str` realloc. Split into `step/text_edit/insert.rs` to keep `text_edit.rs` under 300 lines. | `step/text_edit.rs:27-108`, `:273-280` | **−3 allocs** (insert `String`, Run `String` clone, merge realloc) and one fewer text copy; text splice 7 → 4. | Low-medium: preserve run-boundary and `MAX_RUN_BYTES` rules; falls back to existing path outside the fast case. |
| 5 | Store block attributes as `Arc<Attrs>` (or `Arc<[Attr]>`) inside `Block`; cloning a block becomes refcount-only instead of deep-copying every `AttrValue` string/array/map. | `model/block.rs:70-77`, `model/attrs.rs:74-157`, clone sites `step/apply.rs:98`, `apply/mark_owned.rs:67`, `invert.rs`, `transaction_join.rs:101` | **−1 alloc** per edit for attr-bearing blocks (node IDs are common), plus eliminates all `AttrValue` deep copies. | Medium: `Block`/`BlockContent` `PartialEq`/`Clone` semantics and wire/tests must stay byte-identical; field is private, `Block::text` signature can stay. |
| 6 | Replace `History.done: Vec<Group>` with `VecDeque<Group>` and maintain a running `done_bytes` counter so `record`/`info` are O(1). Removes `remove(0)` shifts and the 200-group sum per edit once saturated. | `state/history.rs:82-86, 164-176, 222-242` | 0 alloc change, CPU/material: avoids O(max_groups) memmove + sum every apply (especially visible in any owned benchmark that accumulates history). | Low-medium (internal type; no public exposure of `History` internals). |
| 7 | Merge chunk directory and starts into one `Box<[ChunkEntry { chunk: Arc<Chunk>, start: u32 }]>`. | `model/chunks.rs:31-37, 191-246`, `chunks/in_place.rs:77-101` | Immutable S2: **−1 alloc** and one contiguous directory copy; no effect on the fixed owned path. | Medium: iteration/`PartialEq`/`flat` non-chunked representation must remain consistent. |
| 8 | Inline one range in `StepMap` and one map in `Mapping` (hand-rolled `enum { Inline(..), Boxed(Box<[..]>) }`); avoids the Box for the common single-step case even when mapping is needed. | `step/map.rs:29-47, 130-141` | **−1 to −2 allocs** per step/transaction. | Medium: `ranges()`/`maps()` must still return slices; no new dependency. |
| 9 | `Vec::with_capacity(steps.len())` for `inverse` (both paths) and pre-size `replace_text` `items` with `block.items().len()+1`. | `state/mod.rs:154`, `state/apply_owned.rs:42`, `step/text_edit.rs:39` | 0 alloc delta for 1 step; avoids growth for 10-step transactions and multi-run blocks. | Low. |
| 10 | Make `TextBlock::new` compute `len` incrementally instead of `recompute_len()` per push (currently O(runs²)). | `model/text.rs:88-121, 224-228` | 0 alloc; CPU win for S3/256-run blocks. | Low. |
| 11 | Coalesce the two index lookups in `locate` (`block_at` + `block_range` both partition the same starts) into one `Chunks::locate(pos) -> (index, absolute_start, &Arc<Block>)`; also lets `invert` avoid its second `locate` for the end position. | `step/apply.rs:224-236`, `step/invert.rs:112-152` | 0 alloc; halves index lookups per step (5 → ~2–3). | Low. |
| 12 | `ChangeSet.ranges`: keep `Vec<RangeChange>` or size the Vec exactly so `into_boxed_slice` cannot shrink-realloc. | `state/change.rs:59-118` | **−1 alloc** per apply. | Low but public-field type change if switched to `Vec`; prefer exact-capacity construction. |

Not worth doing without a larger redesign: `String` → `Arc<str>` for `Run.text` (would make untouched-run clones free, but every edited run still allocates; touches model/wire/tests broadly), and removing `Chunk.starts` (lookups would become O(block) scans).

## 6. Bench gaps

Current `bench/benches/hot_path.rs` (criterion only; `bench/Cargo.toml` has no iai target):

| Bench name | Line | Fixture |
|---|---|---|
| `apply_insert_s2` | `:33-38` | `document(10_000, 100)` (`:29`), `state.apply(transaction.clone())` |
| `apply_insert_s1` | `:48-52` | `document(100, 100)` (`:43`) |
| `from_json_s1` | `:54-60` | same S1 JSON |
| `to_json_string_s2` | `:66-68` | `document(10_000, 100)` |
| `from_json_s2` | `:69-75` | same |
| `a11y_tree_s2` / `validate_a11y_s2` | `:80-85` | `document(10_000, 100)` |
| `serde_json_parse_s2` / `auy_json_parse_s2` / `serde_json_serialize_s2` / `auy_json_serialize_s2` | `:88-110` | same |

`document(blocks, text_len)` (`:12-25`) builds **one `Run` per block**, so S2 here = 10,000 runs (plan target 5,000) and S1 = 100 runs (target 200); no run is ever near the 4 KiB cap.

Missing versus `plan/05_desempenho.md` §1/§2/§3 and `DIVERGENCES.md:66` (gap G):

## Architecture

`EditorState` (`state/mod.rs:52-60`) owns `Doc` (`Arc<DocInner>`, `model/doc.rs:79`) → `Chunks` (flat `Chunk` or `Box<[Arc<Chunk>]>` + `starts`) → `Chunk` (`Box<[Arc<Block>]>` + local `starts`) → `Block` → `TextBlock` (`Vec<InlineItem>`, merged runs with `MarkSet`). A `Transaction` holds owned `Vec<Step>` plus a `base: Option<Doc>` used by `replace_document`/`join_backward`. `apply` clones the `Doc` Arc and always takes the copy-on-write `Chunks::replacing` path; `apply_owned` consumes the state, drops `base`, and takes `Doc::replacing_block_owned` → `Chunks::replacing_in_place`, which mutates the unique `DocInner`/chunk and only suffix-updates `starts`. `step::apply` handles `Replace` text splices (`text_edit::replace_text`), `step::invert` stores the pre-edit text as a `Slice` for history, and `History` records one `Group` per apply. `Editor` wraps `EditorState` and currently clones it before every `apply`, which forces the owned path back onto the COW branch.
